summary.text: Kathleen Brudvig is a Democratic candidate for South Dakota House of Representatives District 10, a two-seat district with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a registered nurse who lives in Sioux Falls.

paragraphs.text: Kathleen Brudvig graduated from Lincoln High School and works as a registered nurse.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she worked her way through nursing school as a young mother, with help from a Pell Grant, Medicaid and income-subsidized housing, and that she is now raising her children in Sioux Falls.

Brudvig listed people-first policies, affordability, transparency and accountability as her key campaign messages, including more affordable health care, support for public education and teachers, worker protections, and access to housing and child care.

She named public schools and health care as the areas of public policy she is most passionate about, and listed District 10 Representative Erin Healy, the South Dakota House Minority Leader, as an endorser.
